papers.title: An Enclosed Mode Is a Gauge Choice: Topology Relative to Reach in Certified Code World Models
papers.abstract: A code world model accepted by a sampling gate can be exactly right on everything the gate can see and arbitrarily wrong beyond it. We characterize what a certified model can know, and what its errors can cost, when the omission is an annular freeze mode enclosing an unreachable interior. The gate quotient makes the question precise: acceptance-with-certainty determines the model exactly on the reachable query set; beyond reach is gauge. On a minimal ring instrument we prove the extreme case (a wrong-topology filled-disc artifact unfalsifiable by any sampling gate and bitwise harmless at play) and measure, with LLM synthesis across three model families, how one knob (a channel of width gamma) walks the same artifact through three regimes: unfalsifiable-and-harmless, falsifiable-and-costly, and instantly falsified. Three principles organize the empirics. First, danger is topology relative to reach: a channel the planner can use collapses the blind model's exploitation (play cost 1.09 to ~0 over a knee at gamma ~ 0.1), while a hidden channel with the same first Betti number keeps it at full strength (1.12). Second, repair is parameter-bound and sensor-bound: no family recovers the region from outside evidence; from inside, models pose the right topology but cannot pin its parameters, and the posed topology tracks the guiding persistent-homology summary's wrong beta_1 (a sensor with a measured geometric resolution limit), not the truth. Third, mitigation must match the error's dimension and direction: point fences fail against the one-dimensional boundary, a dimension-matched persisted fence collapses exploitation to a two-lesson transient (0.999 to 0.058), and the dual freedom certificate collapses the invented-mode failure symmetrically (1.769 to 0.029). In n dimensions the shell makes misidentification near-certain while the danger stays fully exploitable: the two axes are independent.

ai_summary.problem: 认证代码世界模型中，被采样门接受的模型在可达域内可精确正确，但可达域之外可能任意错误，导致错误拓扑（如填充盘伪影）无法被采样门证伪，却可能被规划器利用。
ai_summary.method: 将“封闭模式”重新解释为规范选择，通过门商（gate quotient）精确刻画可达查询集上的确定性，并在最小环仪器上证明极端案例（错误拓扑不可证伪且无害/有害），使用LLM跨三个模型家族合成并测量通道宽度gamma如何使同一伪影经历三种状态，并用持久同调传感器和维度匹配的栅栏/对偶自由证书进行缓解。
ai_summary.result: 危险是拓扑相对于可达性的：可被规划器使用的通道将利用成本从1.09压到~0（gamma~0.1拐点），而具相同第一贝蒂数的隐藏通道保持高成本（1.12）；修复受参数和传感器限制，维度匹配的持久栅栏将利用从0.999降至0.058，对偶自由证书将发明模式故障从1.769降至0.029；高维下壳体使误识别近必然且危险完全可利用。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将认证代码世界模型中不可达区域的误建模形式化为规范自由，并证明错误拓扑与可剥削性在可达性意义下独立，同时给出维度匹配的缓解原则。
ai_summary.relevance: 为可信世界模型、具身智能安全评估提供了拓扑感知的认证框架，揭示了采样门验证的盲区及修复边界。

papers.title: LUCID: An Agentic AI Framework on Digital-Twin in the Loop for QoS-Guaranteeing Robotic Control
papers.abstract: Cloud robotics relies on the timely uplink of high-volume sensing streams, yet dynamic environments continually shift the feasible combinations of trajectories, active-robot count, and per-robot QoS. Because existing approaches formulate trajectory planning (TP) and radio resource management (RRM) as a single fixed optimization problem, they cannot reconfigure these coupled decisions as conditions evolve, resulting in transient QoS violations. However, evolving operator intents change which quantities-such as the active-robot count and per-robot QoS-are fixed, optimized, or relaxed. Furthermore, the computational cost of evaluating trajectory-dependent wireless conflicts has made it difficult to build large-scale Digital-Twin-in-the-Loop (DITL) testbeds responsive enough for such dynamic orchestration. We present LUCID, an LLM-agent--orchestrated, uplink-aware cloud-robotics pipeline that moves TP--RRM from solving a fixed formulation to dynamically orchestrating optimization problem schemas within a DITL environment. Driven by the operator's high-level intent, LUCID treats the TP--RRM formulation as a bounded template whose variables, objectives, and constraints are dynamically configured, while SimBridge enables repeated ray-tracing evaluation by converting large-scale robotics scenes into wireless-ready DTs. By integrating collision-free path planning with a spectral-radius RRM validator, LUCID identifies wireless bottlenecks and restructures the problem schema on the fly to efficiently find the verified feasible state. Experiments confirm that LUCID robustly adapts to changing intents, active-robot counts, and scenes, while a multimodal surrogate model, FastConfigNet, reduces planning latency.

ai_summary.problem: 动态云机器人环境中，轨迹规划与无线资源管理被建模为固定优化问题，无法随环境变化和操作者意图调整，导致服务质量（QoS）违规；同时大规模数字孪生测试床因计算开销过大而难以实现。
ai_summary.method: 提出LUCID框架，利用LLM智能体根据操作者高层意图将TP-RRM优化公式视为可动态配置的模板，变量、目标和约束实时调整；通过SimBridge将大规模机器人场景转换为无线就绪数字孪生并反复进行光线追踪评估，结合无碰撞路径规划与谱半径RRM验证器动态重构问题模式，并引入多模态代理模型FastConfigNet降低规划延迟。
ai_summary.result: 实验证明LUCID能稳健适应变化的意图、机器人数量和场景，同时FastConfigNet显著减少规划延迟，实现高效的可验证可行状态。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将LLM智能体用于动态编排TP-RRM优化问题模式，并以数字孪生循环实现可扩展的无线感知验证。
ai_summary.relevance: 为云机器人和具身智能中的动态资源协同优化提供了新范式，展示了LLM智能体在复合物理-通信系统中的应用潜力。

papers.title: MAP: A Benchmark on Multimodal Accessibility Planning for Real World Places
papers.abstract: We introduce MAP, the first benchmark to evaluate multimodal AI systems as assistants for users with accessibility requirements when planning visits to places in the real world. In our evaluation, systems are presented with requests to verify or recommend a point of interest meeting an accessibility requirement. MAP contains two novel assessments: Claim verification for accessibility planning assesses if information on places and stated accessibility features is supported and identifies places that satisfy requested accessibility features. Visual evidence retrieval for accessibility planning checks if a multimodal AI system can select visual evidence for the requested place and accessibility feature. Our methodology supports comparison of AI systems in a setting where place information and accessibility information can change over time by evaluating systems and refreshing ground truth data at scheduled times. The benchmark is based on automatic rating and human rating for a proportion of responses.

ai_summary.problem: 评估多模态AI系统作为辅助工具，帮助有无障碍需求的用户规划真实世界地点访问时，缺乏专门的基准测试。
ai_summary.method: 提出MAP基准，包含两个新任务：无障碍规划声明验证（验证地点及无障碍特征信息并识别满足条件的场所）和视觉证据检索（选择对应地点与无障碍特征的视觉证据）；采用自动评分与人工评分结合，并定时刷新数据以应对信息变化。
ai_summary.result: MAP作为首个此类基准，支持系统比较和持续评估，能有效衡量AI系统在真实世界无障碍规划中的表现。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出针对真实世界地点无障碍规划的多模态AI系统评估基准，包含两项创新性任务。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态AI在包容性出行辅助领域提供标准化评估方法，推动无障碍智能助手的发展。

papers.title: Semantic Head Specialization Guides Hybrid ViT Attention for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Hybrid attention dominates frontier LLMs, yet Vision Transformers (ViTs) in multimodal LLMs lack a satisfactory hybrid design, with no consensus on why certain attention patterns work better. To fill this gap, we study ViT attention heads and find they differentiate into object- and background-specialist roles, a pattern most pronounced under full attention; we call this Semantic Head Specialization (SHS). We propose SHS-Index to quantify this specialization, show that it distinguishes full-attention from chunk-window ViTs, and find that it strongly tracks downstream benchmark performance. We then identify three structural factors that shape SHS---window interaction, token serialization, and local softmax allocation---and use them as design principles for hybrid attention. Guided by these factors, we design Ariadne Attention, a hybrid that matches full attention on 22 image and video tasks at 6.5x less attention compute. Our findings establish head specialization as a measurable property for diagnosing and designing principled hybrid ViT attention at the multimodal-LLM scale.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大语言模型中的视觉Transformer注意力缺乏有效的混合设计，且对于何种注意力模式更有效缺乏统一认识。
ai_summary.method: 研究发现视觉Transformer注意力头会分化为对象和背景专门化角色，提出SHS-Index量化该特化现象，并识别出窗口交互、令牌序列化和局部softmax分配三个结构性因素，据此设计了混合注意力Ariadne Attention。
ai_summary.result: Ariadne Attention在22个图像和视频任务上与全注意力性能相当，同时注意力计算量减少6.5倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将注意力头特化作为可量化属性，用于诊断和设计多模态大语言模型中的混合视觉Transformer注意力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大语言模型的高效注意力设计提供了基于可测量现象的原则性方法，有助于推动更高效的视觉-语言模型发展。

papers.title: Focus Where It Counts: A Salience-Driven Vision-Language Model for Low Vision Assistance
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are rapidly progressing and offer promising capabilities for assistive technologies supporting persons with blindness or low vision. However, existing VLMs are primarily designed for general-purpose captioning and do not explicitly model human perceptual priorities, thereby limiting their ability to emphasize the most relevant information in a scene. To address this gap, we propose a salience-driven captioning framework that prioritizes scene elements according to their importance for human-centered assistance. We curate three salience-aware datasets, namely, Salience COCO, Salience Flickr, and Salience VizWiz, with object-level salience annotations designed to reflect the visual information most relevant to low vision users across different environments. Building on these datasets, we introduce Salience-LLaVA, a salience-aware VLM that incorporates salience cues to generate captions in which important elements are mentioned in the order of importance. Our work makes four main contributions. We build salience-aware datasets verified by low vision participants, propose Salience-LLaVA to describe objects in the order of importance, introduce SCMI to evaluate ordering accuracy, and deploy the system on assistive glasses to demonstrate real-world practicality. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/topo-focus/Topofocus

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）主要面向通用图像描述，未显式建模人类感知优先级，难以在低视力辅助场景中突出对用户最关键的场景信息。
ai_summary.method: 提出一个显著性驱动的图像描述框架，构建三个带物体级显著性标注的数据集（Salience COCO、Salience Flickr、Salience VizWiz），并训练Salience-LLaVA模型，按重要性顺序生成描述；同时提出SCMI指标评估排序准确性。
ai_summary.result: 构建的数据集经低视力参与者验证，Salience-LLaVA能够按重要性顺序描述物体，并在辅助眼镜上完成实际部署，证明了系统在真实场景中的可用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将人类显著性感知显式引入VLM辅助描述生成，通过排序式描述和专用评估指标提升低视力辅助的实用性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLM在辅助技术中的应用提供了新范式，推动多模态模型从通用描述向人本关怀与感知优先级建模发展。
ai_summary.org: 未明确标注机构，但从作者姓名推测可能为美国高校或研究机构。

papers.title: AcrossVAM1.0: Particle World Modeling for Text-Assisted Robot Video Prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting robot videos requires both precise motion reasoning and preservation of high-frequency appearance, yet monolithic pixel models entangle these objectives and often conceal their progress behind a strong last-frame baseline. We present AcrossVAM1.0, a lightweight, text-assisted video action model that factorizes future prediction into object-centric motion and dense appearance. A frozen SAM3-DLP codec decomposes four context frames into semantic particles for the robot, arm, and gripper, together with a background latent. A 0.28M-parameter spatio-temporal Transformer aligns particle identities, rolls their states forward, and is modulated by a frozen OpenCLIP instruction embedding through FiLM. A causal dual-stream decoder combines particle-rendered motion with appearance encoded exclusively from the last observed frame; a residual refiner and learned delivery mask produce five future frames without access to future appearance. On our VRS benchmark constructed from diverse real-robot trajectories, particle dynamics reduce trajectory error by 21.0\% over persistence. Across three delivery-mask seeds, AcrossVAM1.0 improves future-frame PSNR/SSIM from 19.97/0.796 to 20.573/0.8004, while raw particle generation improves motion-region PSNR from 11.89 to 13.23. The delivered model does not yet beat persistence in LPIPS, and correct-versus- shuffled language changes trajectory error by only 2.8--3.1%. We report these limitations alongside oracle, negative-control, multi-seed, and per-robot analyses. The results show that explicit particle dynamics are a promising low-dimensional interface for robot video prediction, while robust language grounding and appearance delivery remain the principal open challenges.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人视频预测需要同时处理精确的运动推理和高频外观保持，但现有单一块状像素模型将二者纠缠，且性能常被强last-frame基线掩盖，难以体现真实进展。
ai_summary.method: 提出AcrossVAM1.0，将未来预测分解为物体级运动与密集外观：用冻结的SAM3-DLP编解码器将上下文帧分解为机器人、手臂、夹爪的语义粒子及背景潜变量，通过0.28M参数的时空Transformer对齐并滚动粒子状态，同时用OpenCLIP指令经FiLM调制；因果双流解码器结合粒子渲染的运动与仅来自最后一帧的外观，并利用残差精炼器和学习到的投递掩码生成未来帧。
ai_summary.result: 在VRS基准上，粒子动力学将轨迹误差比持久性降低21.0%；三个投递掩码种子下，未来帧PSNR/SSIM从19.97/0.796提升至20.573/0.8004，运动区域PSNR从11.89提升至13.23；但LPIPS仍未超过持久性基线，语言条件对轨迹误差影响仅2.8-3.1%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将大型冻结视觉基础模型（SAM3-DLP）与极轻量时空Transformer结合，用显式粒子动力学作为机器人视频预测的低维运动接口，实现运动与外观的显式解耦。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人视频预测提供了一种可解释、低维的粒子世界模型范式，并揭示了语言接地与外观投递仍是该方向的核心开放挑战，对世界模型和具身智能研究具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者未提供机构信息）

papers.title: ARC-CT: Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Vision-Language Learning for 3D Chest CT
papers.abstract: Contrastive vision-language learning uses paired chest CT volumes and radiology reports to learn abnormality classifiers without manually annotated labels. However, two characteristics of chest CT challenge conventional global contrastive learning. First, many critical abnormalities are small or anatomically localized, and pooling an en- tire volume into a single embedding may dilute their visual evidence. Second, the standard contrastive objective treats every other scan in a batch as a negative. Because many chest CTs share abnormalities, this objective incorrectly pushes co-positive pairs apart. We propose Anatomy-Routed Contrastive Learning for 3D Chest CT (ARC-CT), a region-aware framework that addresses these limitations using only la- bels extracted from reports by an LLM, with no manual annotations or bounding boxes. ARC-CT combines three components: (1) an Anato- myQFormer localizing evidence via queries constrained by automatically generated organ masks; (2) a label-Jaccard soft InfoNCE objective in- tegrating the standard one-hot target with the label-set overlap of each pair, which reduces false-negative penalties between studies that share clinical findings; and (3) an organ-level alignment loss connecting mask- pooled visual features to organ-specific report text extracted offline with a large language model. ARC-CT achieves a 0.86 mask-free macro AUC across 18 abnormalities using a compact 3D ResNet-18 backbone. Over- all, ARC-CT outperforms both comparable efficient baselines and sev- eral larger transformer models. Our code and weights are available at https://github.com/arc-ct/arc-ct.

ai_summary.problem: 现有全局对比视觉语言学习在3D胸部CT上存在两个问题：小异常被全局池化稀释；标准对比目标错误惩罚共享异常的正样本对。
ai_summary.method: 提出ARC-CT框架，包含三个组件：AnatomyQFormer用自动器官掩膜约束查询定位局部证据；标签Jaccard软InfoNCE损失减少假阴性惩罚；器官级对齐损失将视觉特征与LLM提取的报告文本对齐。
ai_summary.result: 在18类异常上达到0.86无掩膜宏观AUC，优于同规模基线和更大的transformer模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 将解剖路由、软对比目标和器官级文本对齐结合，无需手动标注即可实现区域感知的对比学习。
ai_summary.relevance: 为医学影像自监督学习提供了处理细粒度局部异常和标签噪声的新范式。

papers.title: Post-Training VLMs for Video Mistake Detection
papers.abstract: Human mistakes are inevitable when following instructions, yet they can lead to severe consequences. As such, there has been an increased interest in developing methods for detecting mistakes in videos, with current methods mostly focusing on closed-set protocols. While successful in controlled settings, the closed-set assumption limits their wider applicability, as any changes to the task require collecting new data and re-training models. Instead, we argue that mistake detection methods should learn the general concept of a mistake, rather than overfitting to step-specific details. To reflect this, we introduce the Mistake Detection Video Question Answering (MD-VQA) protocol and accompanying benchmark. MD-VQA tests whether methods can discern if a step was executed correctly with respect to its description, for both seen and unseen actions. To address this important challenge, we propose the first video-language-model post-training technique for mistake detection. Our method uses a tailored reward function to encourage the model to identify discrepancies between an instruction and the corresponding video. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that this approach outperforms zero-shot, supervised fine-tuning, and post-training baselines. Notably, our method generalizes especially well to unseen procedures, for instance, with an improvement of up to 11.6% over the best-performing baseline on EP-VQA, paving the way toward general mistake detection. We release our code and benchmark at https://github.com/FedeSpu/mstk.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视频错误检测方法依赖封闭集协议，无法泛化到未见过的任务或步骤，需要一种能学习通用“错误”概念的方法。
ai_summary.method: 提出MD-VQA协议和基准，并设计首个针对视频大语言模型的post-training技术，通过定制奖励函数促使模型识别指令与视频之间的不一致性。
ai_summary.result: 该方法在多个基准上优于零样本、监督微调和post-training基线，尤其对未见程序提升显著，最高比最优基线提高11.6%（EP-VQA）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将视频大语言模型post-training应用于通用错误检测，并引入面向错误检测的专门奖励函数和开放集基准MD-VQA。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动视频理解模型从场景记忆走向真正的推理与泛化，对具身智能和在线任务监控具有重要价值。

papers.title: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents
papers.abstract: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long and flat intervals along the same stock's intraday path after removing the overall fraction of long decisions. This exposure-matched measure reveals persistent negative timing across modality, horizon, state, and model family. Shuffling saved action sequences substantially attenuates the effect, showing that alignment between actions and subsequent returns drives the negative score. Feeding self-authored memories into decisions further increases policy persistence, while timing becomes more negative among stock-days on which the agent uses both actions. These results reveal stable, recoverable directional structure in sequential LLM financial decisions and a behavioral signal for studying how another participant could respond to a predictable policy.

ai_summary.problem: 研究大语言模型（LLM）交易代理在时序决策中是否表现出可预测的方向性结构，即其行为是否被其他市场参与者利用。
ai_summary.method: 提出RetailAgent实验框架，让LLM观察匿名日内股价历史并反复选择多头或空仓，通过暴露匹配度量比较多头与空仓期间的收益，并采用记忆注入和动作序列洗牌等分析验证行为结构。
ai_summary.result: 发现LLM代理存在跨模态、视野、状态和模型家族的持续性负向择时效应，且自生成记忆加剧策略持续性，双动作使用时择时更差，表明可恢复的方向性结构确实存在。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过暴露匹配的因果式度量揭示LLM交易代理的稳定方向性时序偏差，并识别其与动作-收益对齐及记忆增强的关联。
ai_summary.relevance: 为理解LLM在金融决策中的可预测性提供了行为信号，对设计对抗性市场交互策略和AI安全评估有重要意义。

papers.title: Cross-Spectral Dense Correspondence for Multimodal Spectral Medical Imaging
papers.abstract: Precise dense correspondence is a fundamental prerequisite for multimodal spectral imaging systems that fuse disparate wavelength ranges for subsequent analysis in medical and scientific imaging. Corresponding image points are often observed with non-overlapping spectral sensitivities, leading to wavelength-dependent contrast changes, intensity inversions, and appearance shifts for which dense ground truth is difficult to obtain and conventional RGB-based training data provides only limited supervision. We address this data gap by introducing a sensor-agnostic cross-spectral modulation protocol on established correspondence benchmarks with intensity input projection, and by proposing a synthetic cross-spectral correspondence benchmark simulating physically plausible radiometric differences. Evaluation on several modern dense correspondence backbones trained with our unified cross-spectral protocol showed substantial improvements under severe spectral mismatch while maintaining performance on standard RGB benchmarks. Ablation experiments show that view-dependent channel selection and nonlinear radiometric transformations provide complementary robustness, indicating that the primary limitation of existing models is not their structural matching capacity but the mismatch between training distribution and spectral characteristics of the target image pair. Qualitative evaluations on heterogeneous medical spectral acquisition systems demonstrate the practical relevance of the proposed training data augmentation protocol as an enabler for spatially coherent spectral fusion in HSI workflows.

ai_summary.problem: 多光谱医学成像中，不同波长下图像间存在强烈的表观差异，导致难以获得密集对应关系，而现有RGB训练数据无法提供足够的监督。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种与传感器无关的跨光谱调制协议，在既有对应基准上通过强度输入投影进行数据增强，并构建一个模拟物理辐射差异的合成跨光谱对应基准，用于训练多种现代密集对应骨干网络。
ai_summary.result: 在严重光谱失配条件下显著提升匹配性能，同时保持RGB基准的精度；消融实验表明视角相关通道选择和非线性辐射变换具有互补鲁棒性，并验证了该协议在异构医疗光谱采集系统中的实际有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地针对跨光谱密集对应任务提出训练数据增强协议和合成基准，并揭示现有模型的瓶颈在于训练分布与目标光谱特征失配而非结构匹配能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态医疗成像和HSI工作流提供可泛化的数据增强策略，推动跨光谱视觉匹配在医学AI及世界模型感知中的应用。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构信息未明确列出，但根据姓名和论文主题推测可能来自德国弗劳恩霍夫研究院或相关高校

papers.title: Abstract4D: A Large-Scale Dataset and Framework for Understanding the Visual Language of Abstract Art
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence can classify artistic styles and synthesize images, but it still lacks a model of the visual language that gives art meaning. Abstract painting minimizes object semantics and foregrounds structural cues, making it an ideal testbed for computational perception. We introduce \textbf{Abstract4D}, the largest dataset of abstract paintings to date: more than 120,000 images paired with rich metadata and multi-dimensional prompts that capture each work's perceptual attributes---\textit{form, color, texture, and composition}. Annotations are produced by a hybrid human--VLM pipeline for quality and consistency. Using Abstract4D, we (i) analyze the semantic structure of abstract art through large-scale embedding visualization, uncovering how perceptual relationships organize artistic meaning, and (ii) establish benchmark tasks for classification, cross-modal retrieval, and text-to-image generation to evaluate how AI models perceive and reproduce abstract visual language. Together, these analyses demonstrate how Abstract4D enables both exploration and quantitative assessment of AI's ability to represent and interpret abstract art.

ai_summary.problem: AI虽能分类艺术风格和合成图像，但缺乏对赋予艺术意义的视觉语言的理解模型，抽象画因弱化物体语义、突出结构线索而成为理想测试平台。
ai_summary.method: 构建了目前最大的抽象画数据集Abstract4D，包含超12万张图像及多维提示词（形式、色彩、质感、构图），采用人工与VLM混合流程标注，并利用嵌入可视化分析语义结构，同时建立分类、跨模态检索、文生图基准任务。
ai_summary.result: Abstract4D揭示了抽象艺术中感知关系如何组织艺术意义，并为评估AI理解和再现抽象视觉语言提供了量化基准。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提供大规模、多维标注的抽象画数据集及配套分析框架，用于系统研究AI对抽象视觉语言的感知与生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态大模型与世界模型在艺术语义理解、跨模态对齐和创造性生成方面的发展。

papers.title: AIM: Anchor Identity Features, Then Match for Multimodal Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can memorize identity-specific facts about people in their fine-tuning data, creating privacy risks when a person requests deletion. Existing MLLM unlearning methods often assume access to retain images or ground-truth answers during deletion, which is unrealistic in many practical scenarios. We study identity unlearning when retain images are unavailable at deletion time. Our analysis shows that identity and visual-perception questions occupy distinct regions in fine-tuned hidden states and are organized differently: identity questions cluster by person, whereas perception questions cluster by question type. This suggests that identity knowledge can be suppressed without erasing general visual perception. Building on this observation, we propose AIM, a two-stage method that anchors an identity-forgetting target with a universal visual prompt and then matches the vision encoder to that target under a Fisher-based constraint. Extensive experiments show that AIM achieves competitive identity forgetting while preserving non-deleted identities, prior knowledge, and visual perception on the same images.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在微调数据中会记忆人物身份信息，用户请求删除时，现有方法往往依赖保留图像或真实答案，这在现实中不现实，本文研究在删除时无保留图像情况下的身份遗忘问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出AIM两阶段方法：先用通用视觉提示锚定一个身份遗忘目标，再在Fisher信息约束下将视觉编码器匹配到该目标，从而抑制身份知识而不破坏通用视觉感知。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明AIM在保持非目标身份、先验知识和同一图像的视觉感知的同时，实现了有竞争力的身份遗忘效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在无保留图像的条件下利用隐藏状态中身份问题与视觉感知问题的分布差异，通过锚定-匹配机制实现精准身份遗忘。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型的身份隐私保护提供了一种实用且高效的机器遗忘方法，推动可信AI在实际场景中的应用。

papers.title: STEGNav: Spatio-Temporal Event Graph Reasoning for Multimodal Lifelong Object Navigation
papers.abstract: Multimodal lifelong navigation requires an agent to autonomously explore unseen environments while sequentially completing navigation tasks specified by object categories, language descriptions, or reference images. Existing methods primarily accomplish these tasks by constructing state-centric semantic scene graphs. By treating scene graphs as persistent repositories of semantic observations, these methods struggle to distinguish similar instances, jointly represent semantic targets and exploration frontiers, and effectively exploit navigation memory and trajectory experience. To address these limitations, we propose Spatio-Temporal Event Graph Navigation (STEGNav), a training-free framework that extends conventional scene graphs into spatio-temporal event graphs along complementary spatial and temporal axes. The spatial axis performs query-conditioned instance grounding and jointly represents semantic targets and occupancy-aware exploration frontiers characterized by reachability, path cost, and exploration utility. The temporal axis employs trajectory-aware dual-window memory to retain recent decision--trajectory events and verified cross-subtask navigation outcomes. A VLM-based navigation agent reasons over the resulting spatio-temporal event graph and selects either a target instance or an exploration frontier as its next navigation goal. STEGNav achieves 66.3% SR and 39.7 SPL on GOAT-Bench, as well as SR scores of 64.0% and 69.4% on HM3Dv1 and HM3Dv2, respectively. Ablation studies and error analyses validate the complementary effects of the two axes, demonstrating that event-driven spatio-temporal representations improve navigation reliability and cross-subtask experience reuse.

ai_summary.problem: 解决多模态终身对象导航中现有场景图方法难以区分相似实例、联合表示语义目标与探索边界、有效利用导航记忆和轨迹经验的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出STEGNav，一种无需训练的框架，将传统场景图扩展为时空事件图：空间轴进行查询条件实例定位并联合表示目标与占据感知的探索边界；时间轴采用轨迹感知双窗口记忆保留决策事件和跨子任务结果。基于VLM的导航代理对事件图推理以选择目标或探索边界。
ai_summary.result: 在GOAT-Bench上达66.3% SR和39.7 SPL，HM3Dv1/v2上SR为64.0%/69.4%，消融实验验证了两轴的互补效应，提升了导航可靠性和跨子任务经验复用。
ai_summary.novelty: 将场景图扩展为包含空间实例定位与时间轨迹记忆的时空事件图，实现无需训练的VLM驱动导航推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态具身导航提供事件驱动的时空表示新范式，推动世界模型和Agent在复杂环境中的长期决策研究。

papers.title: Learning to Transfer Across Modes: Towards Unified Urban Mobility Forecasting
papers.abstract: Urban transportation systems consist of multiple mobility modes that coexist within the same city and exhibit complex interdependencies, leading to correlated demand dynamics across modes. However, forecasting demand jointly across different modes remains challenging due to substantial heterogeneity in space and the limited availability of historical data for emerging modes. Existing forecasting methods are largely developed for individual mobility modes and implicitly assume compatible spatial structures between source and target systems, which severely restricts their applicability in multi-modal settings. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{TransMod}, a unified framework for urban mobility demand forecasting that enables effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous mobility modes. TransMod constructs a shared zone-level spatial representation that aligns mobility systems with different spatial granularities into a common space, thereby reducing structural mismatch and distributional shift. Built on this unified representation, TransMod further learns transferable spatio-temporal patterns from data-rich source modes and adapts them to data-scarce target modes, alleviating the dependence on extensive target-domain histories. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that TransMod consistently outperforms existing approaches and provides robust forecasting performance under limited target data.

ai_summary.problem: 城市交通多模式共存且相互依赖，但现有预测方法多针对单一模式，难以处理不同空间粒度造成的结构异质性以及新兴模式历史数据不足的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出TransMod统一框架，通过构建共享的区域级空间表示将不同空间粒度的移动系统对齐到公共空间，并在该表示上从数据丰富的源模式学习可迁移的时空模式，再适配到数据稀缺的目标模式。
ai_summary.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，TransMod一致优于现有方法，且在目标数据有限时仍能提供稳健的预测性能。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在统一空间表示下实现跨异质移动模式的知识迁移，缓解结构不匹配和分布偏移。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态交通预测提供了通用范式，有助于推动城市智能体中跨系统迁移学习的发展。

papers.title: CoCoBench: A Cooperative Coordination Benchmark for Embodied Multi-Agent Task Planning
papers.abstract: Agent systems powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in recent years, yet existing embodied-agent benchmarks still lack fine-grained diagnostics for multi-agent coordination. Most benchmarks either focus on single-agent task completion or summarize multi-agent behavior with overall task success rates, which can obscure coordination failures such as duplicated work, violations of ordering constraints, resource contention, and desynchronized handoffs. In this paper, we introduce CoCoBench, a construct-level benchmark for evaluating multi-agent embodied coordination in executable household tasks. CoCoBench contains 897 oracle-validated instances organized around four recurring coordination constructs: task allocation, sequential ordering, mutual exclusion, and handoff coordination. In addition to task success rate, CoCoBench provides construct-level scores that measure whether agents coordinate effectively. We evaluate 11 leading MLLMs across different coordination modes, observation inputs, and numbers of agents. The results show that coordination ability is highly construct-specific: strong overall performance does not imply balanced competence across different coordination types. These findings point to new directions for designing targeted model architectures and improving multi-agent coordination ability.

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身智能体基准缺乏对多智能体协调的细粒度诊断，多以整体任务成功率掩盖协调失败，如重复工作、顺序违规、资源竞争和不同步交接。
ai_summary.method: 提出CoCoBench基准，包含897个oracle验证实例，围绕任务分配、顺序排序、互斥和交接协调四个构件设计，并提供构件级分数以衡量协调有效性。
ai_summary.result: 对11个主流MLLM评估发现，协调能力高度构件特定，整体性能强不代表各协调类型均衡发展。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出面向具身多智能体协调的构件级基准，实现细粒度诊断而非仅整体成功率。
ai_summary.relevance: 为设计针对性模型架构和提升多智能体协调能力提供了新方向，推动具身智能体协同研究。

papers.title: Synth-JDoc: Synthesizing a Japanese Document Image Dataset for OCR with Diverse Layouts and Embedded Images
papers.abstract: The ability of Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) to read text within document images is crucial, as it enables various applications such as Document Visual Question Answering. To enhance the text-reading capabilities of LVLMs, high-quality OCR datasets are essential. This need is particularly critical for Japanese documents, which often feature vertically written text alongside horizontally written text. Current LVLMs demonstrate considerably lower performance on vertically written Japanese text than on horizontally written text, necessitating specialized OCR datasets to bridge this gap. However, manually constructing OCR datasets is expensive and difficult to scale. Alternatively, constructing datasets by extracting text from existing document images using OCR models introduces challenges, such as text recognition errors and the prerequisite of sourcing document images.   To address these issues, we construct an OCR dataset by synthesizing document images directly from text. Leveraging HTML and CSS, we generate multi-column documents that incorporate both vertical and horizontal writing styles. Furthermore, to ensure the visual realism of the documents, we embed images generated by text-to-image models within the layout. Additionally, to foster model robustness, we apply noise and degradation filters to the synthesized document images. In our experiments, we compared the performance of models fine-tuned on our synthetic dataset against baselines fine-tuned on synthetic datasets from prior work and those generated by a high-performance text-to-image model. Evaluation results demonstrate that our synthetic dataset is the most effective approach for improving LVLM performance on reading vertically written Japanese text. Our dataset and code are publicly available (https://github.com/llm-jp/synth-jdoc).

ai_summary.problem: 现有LVLM在识别日语文档图像中的纵向文本时性能显著低于横向文本，而手工构建或基于OCR提取的日语OCR数据集成本高、易出错且难以扩展。
ai_summary.method: 利用HTML和CSS直接从文本合成包含纵横混排和多栏版式的文档图像，嵌入文生图模型生成的图像以增强视觉真实性，并施加噪声和退化滤波提升鲁棒性。
ai_summary.result: 在微调LVLM的评估中，基于该合成数据集训练的模型在阅读日语纵向文本上的表现优于先前工作和高性能文生图模型生成的合成数据集。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次针对日语纵向文本识别，提出利用HTML/CSS可控合成含图文混排的高质量OCR数据集的方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 为提升LVLM在日语文档理解（尤其是纵向文本）上的能力提供了低成本、可扩展的数据构建范式。

papers.title: GeBDA: Building Damage Assessment as Text-Based Sequence Prediction
papers.abstract: Conventionally, Building Damage Assessment (BDA) is tackled either with dedicated network architectures or by fine-tuning geospatial image foundation models. In this work, we ask whether a general-purpose Vision-Language Model (VLM) can localize buildings and grade their damage through autoregressive sequence generation alone. We cast BDA as predicting a variable-length set of bounding boxes, each specified by its coordinates and a damage label. Our preliminary implementation, based on the open Gemma model, achieves promising damage mapping results from only bi-temporal satellite images and a suitable text prompt.

ai_summary.problem: 传统建筑破坏评估（BDA）依赖专用网络或微调地理空间基础模型，本文探究通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）能否仅通过自回归序列生成实现建筑定位与破坏分级。
ai_summary.method: 将BDA转化为预测一组可变长度的边界框序列，每个框由坐标和破坏标签构成；基于开源的Gemma模型，输入双时相卫星图像和文本提示，直接生成破坏映射结果。
ai_summary.result: 初步实验表明，该方法在仅使用双时相卫星图像时即可获得有前景的建筑破坏映射效果，验证了通用VLM用于BDA的可行性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将建筑破坏评估完全建模为基于文本的自回归序列预测任务，无需专用网络架构或微调地理空间基础模型。
ai_summary.relevance: 拓展了通用视觉-语言模型在地理空间遥感领域的应用边界，为多模态大模型用于灾害响应和智能体感知提供了新思路。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未明确，但Konrad Schindler隶属于苏黎世联邦理工学院（ETH Zurich）

papers.title: Conditional Visual Evidence Utility: State-Dependent Rank Reversals in Frozen Vision-Language Encoders
papers.abstract: Static importance scores compress visual evidence into a single ranking, but the value of remaining evidence can change after one cue has been observed. We study this possibility in controlled compositional visual search, where color, shape, and texture evidence can be independently exposed and their conditional marginal utility measured across acquisition states. In a held-out confirmation on 800 scenes, frozen OpenCLIP and SigLIP exhibit robust state-dependent rank reversals that concentrate in candidate-overlap regimes designed to induce ordering changes. The structure persists across two evidence-accumulation constructions and ten equivalent query wordings, but disappears under query-scene derangement. We also ask whether these reversals matter for decisions. In a post-confirmation exploratory matched-first-action analysis, reranking only after the first acquisition yields positive step-2 utility when decisions are selected under one evidence mode, wording, or backbone and evaluated under another. Together, these results show that evidence importance is state-dependent in this controlled setup and that updating an evidence ordering can retain decision-relevant value across evaluator changes. They motivate evaluating vision-language evidence use conditionally rather than through a single static ranking, while providing a measurable target for future adaptive evidence-selection methods.

ai_summary.problem: 静态重要性分数将视觉证据压缩为单一排序，但观察到一条线索后剩余证据的价值可能改变，现有方法忽略了这种状态依赖的效用变化。
ai_summary.method: 在受控的组合性视觉搜索中，独立暴露颜色、形状和纹理证据，测量不同获取状态下的条件边际效用，并在冻结的OpenCLIP和SigLIP上进行验证，同时构建候选重叠场景与多种查询措辞进行测试。
ai_summary.result: 冻结的视觉语言编码器表现出稳健的状态依赖排序反转，集中出现在候选重叠区域；重新排序策略在跨评估者变化时仍保留决策价值。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地提出并验证了视觉语言编码器证据重要性的状态依赖性问题，而非依赖单一静态排序。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型中的自适应证据选取方法提供了可测量的目标，推动视觉语言证据评估走向条件化。

papers.title: Training-free Suction Grasp Detection for Deformed Aseptic Cartons Using Vision-Language Models and Geometric Surface Scoring
papers.abstract: Robotic sorting of recyclable waste is challenging due to the deformable and geometrically inconsistent nature of target objects. We present a training-free suction grasping system for sorting deformed aseptic beverage cartons, decoupling target identification from grasp-point selection. An open-vocabulary vision-language model detects cartons from a text prompt, SAM2 refines each detection into an instance mask, and a geometric scoring method selects the suction point by combining surface flatness with normal alignment. Three geometric methods are compared: k-nearest-neighbour PCA, Sobel cross-product, and RANSAC plane fitting. Evaluated on a real robot across three deformation levels and 35 cluttered scenes, single-object grasp success reaches 88.2% and end-to-end retrieval in clutter is 72.6%.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人分拣可回收废物时，变形无菌饮料纸盒的几何形状不规则，导致吸盘抓取检测困难。
ai_summary.method: 采用开放词汇视觉语言模型通过文本提示检测纸盒，SAM2细化实例分割，并用几何表面评分（结合平整度与法向对齐）选择吸盘抓取点，比较了KNN-PCA、Sobel叉积和RANSAC平面拟合三种几何方法。
ai_summary.result: 在真实机器人上，单物体抓取成功率达88.2%，杂乱场景下端到端回收成功率为72.6%。
ai_summary.novelty: 无需训练的吸盘抓取检测，将目标识别与抓取点选择解耦，并融合视觉语言模型与几何表面评分。
ai_summary.relevance: 为变形物体抓取提供了一种无需训练数据的可行方案，展示了视觉语言模型在具身操作中的潜力。

papers.title: WALDO: One-Shot Exemplar-Conditioned Object Detection in Cluttered Scenes
papers.abstract: Locating a specific object instance in a cluttered scene using a single reference image and a short description, and reporting when that instance is absent, large vision-language models usually address this task. We ask whether the same capability is available far more cheaply, from representations already learned by a world-model pretraining objective. We present WALDO, a one-shot exemplar- and language-conditioned detection head with 3.4M trainable parameters that reads frozen V-JEPA 2.1 features to jointly predict object localization and target presence, with no gradient on the backbone. Because exemplar-conditioned supervision is scarce, we synthesize training episodes from instance annotations, mining exemplars from ground-truth boxes and constructing absence cases that exclude the referenced instance while leaving same-category distractors in view. This is easy to get wrong: in the obvious implementation, crop size alone predicts the label, and a head trained on it reaches 0.9998 absence AUROC without ever consulting the exemplar, and we report the negative controls that close the shortcut. On 35 held-out cluttered scenes, WALDO achieves a 0.461 catalogue AP@50, compared to 0.306 for a prompted Grounding DINO baseline under an identical scorer. Substituting DINOv3 for V-JEPA under a matched 576-token grid drops within-category absence AUROC from 0.880 to 0.726 and instance AP@50 from 0.201 to 0.141, isolating the pretraining objective rather than input resolution as the source of the gain. Instance-level Success@1, however, reaches only 0.190 against a 0.190 category-chance floor: world-model features transfer to localization precision and absence detection but not to instance identity.

ai_summary.problem: 探索是否能用世界模型预训练学到的表征，以比大型视觉语言模型更廉价的方式实现杂乱场景中的一次性实例检测与存在性判断。
ai_summary.method: 提出WALDO，一个3.4M可训练参数的检测头，读取冻结的V-JEPA 2.1特征，同时预测目标定位和存在性；从标注框合成训练episode，挖掘示例并构造类别干扰物保留的缺席案例，并通过负控制消除捷径。
ai_summary.result: 在35个场景上达到0.461的catalogue AP@50，优于Grounding DINO的0.306；但实例级Success@1仅0.190，与类别随机基线持平，表明世界模型特征能迁移到定位和缺席检测，不能迁移到实例身份。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次利用世界模型冻结特征进行一次性示例条件检测，并系统揭示和规避了训练中的捷径问题。
ai_summary.relevance: 验证了世界模型表征对下游视觉任务的迁移价值，为低成本实例检索和异常检测提供新思路，同时揭示了实例级识别的瓶颈。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日论文集中在多模态与大型语言模型的交叉应用，涵盖视觉理解、医疗影像、机器人导航、智能体决策等方向；同时世界模型相关研究升温，特别是将冻结视觉基础模型与轻量架构结合用于视频预测和感知。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日收录论文中无大厂（如Google、Meta、Microsoft等）直接参与，因此不存在大厂方向重合，各论文主要来自学术机构或独立研究团队。
daily_insight.signals: 世界模型方向出现多篇论文（如AcrossVAM1.0、WALDO、An Enclosed Mode等），且开始探索与多模态、机器人任务的融合，可能预示该领域从理论走向实际应用；多模态大模型的安全与遗忘（如AIM）也成为新兴关注点。
